declarations.name: AiProvider
declarations.doc: An AI provider of the project config: a model (and optionally an embedder) of one Genkit plugin.

members.name: model
members.doc: The model: `gemini-flash-latest`, `gpt-4o-mini`, `claude-sonnet-4-5`...

members.name: embedder
members.doc: The embedder for the knowledge base: `text-embedding-004`, `text-embedding-3-small`...

declarations.name: Anthropic
declarations.doc: Anthropic's Claude models (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or apiKey).

declarations.name: Chat
declarations.doc: A `chat` kind: a conversation with a model, its system prompt and the tools of its dependencies. It keeps the history of the conversation; send answers at once, stream piece by piece.

members.name: model
members.doc: The provider (connection name) whose model answers.

members.name: prompt
members.doc: The system instruction.

members.name: dependencies
members.doc: The constructor's dependencies: the Tools among them are offered to the model (the dialect writes it).

members.name: send
members.doc: The model's answer to text, remembered in history.

members.name: stream
members.doc: The answer to text as it is generated; the whole answer goes to history when it ends.

declarations.name: ChatController
declarations.doc: The state of a chat screen: the messages, whether an answer is coming and the last error. Listen to it with a ListenableBuilder; send streams the answer into the last message.

declarations.name: ChatMessage
declarations.doc: One message of a ChatController: who wrote it and its text (it grows while the answer streams).

declarations.name: DragonflyGenkit
declarations.doc: The Genkit instance of the app and the models and embedders of its providers, by connection name.

members.name: ai
members.doc: The app's Genkit (started by the generated `startGenkit`).

members.name: start
members.doc: Starts Genkit with the plugins and the models of the providers (the generated `startGenkit` calls it).

members.name: use
members.doc: Uses ai with models as they are (tests: a model of FakeModels).

members.name: model
members.doc: The model of the provider named name (`''`: the provider without `connectionName`).

members.name: embedder
members.doc: The embedder of the provider named name.

declarations.name: FirebaseAI
declarations.doc: Gemini through Firebase AI Logic (App Check, no API key in the app). The app must call Firebase.initializeApp.

members.name: vertexAI
members.doc: true: the Vertex AI backend of Firebase AI Logic; false: the Gemini Developer API.

declarations.name: GenkitFlow
declarations.doc: A `flow` kind: one AI operation with a typed input and output, registered as a Genkit flow (traces, the Developer UI). Call it like a function: `~summarize(text)`.

members.name: flowName
members.doc: The flow's name (the class name in camelCase).

members.name: run
members.doc: What the flow does with its input (the kind's `run` method).

declarations.name: GoogleAI
declarations.doc: Gemini with an API key (GEMINI_API_KEY, or apiKey): for development.

declarations.name: Knowledge
declarations.doc: A `knowledge` kind: texts with their embeddings, searched by meaning (RAG). Its `documents()` method gives the first texts; add adds more; search gives the closest ones to put in a prompt.

members.name: embedderName
members.doc: The provider (connection name) whose embedder is used.

members.name: documents
members.doc: The texts the knowledge starts with (the kind's `documents` method).

members.name: search
members.doc: The k texts closest in meaning to question.

members.name: context
members.doc: The closest texts as one block for a prompt.

declarations.name: KnowledgeHit
declarations.doc: A text of a Knowledge and how close it is to the question (cosine similarity, 1 = the same).

declarations.name: OpenAI
declarations.doc: OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible server through baseUrl (a local Ollama: `http://localhost:11434/v1`).

declarations.name: RemoteFlows
declarations.doc: A `remote` kind: flows deployed on a Genkit server (Node, Go, Python, Dart), called like a repository calls an API. Each method is one flow at `baseUrl/<path>`; one that returns a Stream streams its chunks.

members.name: baseUrl
members.doc: The server (`@remote("https://...")` on the kind).

members.name: headers
members.doc: Headers of every call (a session token): override to add them.

members.name: callFlow
members.doc: Calls the flow at path with input.

members.name: streamFlow
members.doc: Streams the chunks of the flow at path.

declarations.name: Schemas
declarations.doc: The schemas of the app's models (`Character`: a JSON schema of its fields + its fromJson), registered by the generated `dragonfly_genkit.g.dart`: what a flow reads and answers and what the model's structured output is.

members.name: of
members.doc: The schema of T: a model of the app, or a basic type (String, int, double, bool).

members.name: object
members.doc: A JSON schema object with properties (name → JSON schema) and the required names: a tool's input.

declarations.name: Tools
declarations.doc: A `tools` kind: tools gives the Genkit tools of its methods with a doc comment (the dialect writes it); a method without one is a helper of the others.

declarations.name: VertexAI
declarations.doc: Gemini and other models on Google Cloud's Vertex AI.

declarations.name: generateObject
declarations.doc: Structured output: the model answers prompt as a T (a model of the app, validated by its schema).

declarations.name: generateText
declarations.doc: The text the model answers to prompt (with an optional system instruction).

declarations.name: startFakeGenkit
declarations.doc: Starts Genkit with a fake model that answers answers in order (repeating the last one) and a fake embedder (a vector of letter counts: texts with the same words are close).

declarations.name: streamText
declarations.doc: The text of prompt as it is generated.

declarations.name: toolsOf
declarations.doc: The tools of the dependencies of a chat or flow that are Tools.
